## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, tests, build) and `sh scripts/check-repo.sh` is clean
- [ ] Tests added or updated (security-relevant changes need a test that fails without the fix)
- [ ] No secret, API key, password or real hostname in code, tests, fixtures or screenshots
- [ ] Docs/ADR updated if behaviour or configuration changed
- [ ] I agree my contribution is licensed under AGPL-3.0-only
